claims.statement: The exact H-053 predicates are exactSourceBoundaryClosed, candidateConformsProductSpecificationV1, candidateUsesProseCarrierAndSupersedesNull, candidateInternalReferencesAreClosed, transitionIsAtomicAcceptedAddition, profileRetainsExactlyThreeSpecifications, allThreeAreAcceptedAndUnsuperceded, predecessorBytesRemainIdentical, compiledPlanContainsThreeEffectiveAcceptedSpecifications, profileAndCorpusPermutationIsDeterministic, manifestDeltaIsAdditionOnlyAndContentBound, priorEvidenceBecomesStale, and noSpecificationOrImplementationAuthorityIsInferred.

claims.statement: H-053 is supported only when the exact source boundary closes, every positive predicate passes, every required negative control executes with the expected observed host behavior, no real governance or product source changes, and authority remains none with action null; it is refuted only when the exact closed host rejects the authorized atomic accepted addition or cannot produce three effective accepted specifications; it is inconclusive on any omitted, drifted, opaque, ambiguous, contradictory, or unclassifiable source or result; and it is invalid on unauthorized persistence, live or network activity, source mutation, authority overclaim, or self-approval.
claims.evidence: Fail-closed D3 outcome policy derived from ADR-0001, the human grant, and the distinction between exact host admission and normative product authority.

claims.statement: The four required negative controls are proposedToAcceptedRejectedByImmutability, activeSetRemovalAdmittedByHost, supersessionBreaksIndependentActiveSet, and typedRelationshipFieldsRejectedBySchema; the active-set removal control records current host behavior as an enforcement gap if removal is admitted rather than treating that admission as proof of monotonic retention.
claims.evidence: The human grant explicitly requires proposed-to-accepted, active-set removal, supersession, and typed-field controls; static inspection predicts the first, third, and fourth are rejected and that active-set removal is currently admitted.

claims.statement: Whether the current source-locked governance host passes all thirteen predicates and exhibits the four predicted negative-control behaviors remains unknown until the authorized offline harness executes and a separate verifier reconstructs its raw evidence.
claims.evidence: No H-053 fixture, run, or independently verified evidence exists before this proposed contract and Slice.
